title: Canonical Variations
program_note:
Canonical Variations was written in the last week of August, 1990, and was revised in the last week of December, 1991, and the first week of February, 2010.

In structure it is a classical theme and variations, except that each variation is a canon.  Variations I-III and VI-VII are canons at the tritone, the fifth, the octave, the tritone, and the tritone, respectively.  Variations IV and V are crab (retrograde) canons, with a twist:  Variation IV is also a “forward” canon inverted around F#; and Variation V is an inverted retrograde canon around A.  I was fairly liberal with octave transpositions, most especially in Variation V.

I have also given each Variation a title to reflect its character:  Ostinato, Bulgarian Dance, Fantasy, March, Nocturne, Perpetuum Mobile, and Spiral.

The total duration of the work is approximately 11 minutes.

David S. Lefkowitz

28 December, 1991

Rochester, NY

and 9 February, 2010

Los Angeles, CA
